text: In Rome in 1971, the American novice Margaret arrives at a Catholic orphanage to take her vows, and befriends Carlita, a mistreated girl plagued by visions. A nun sets herself alight and hangs herself, and a priest warns that [radicals in the Church|threat|the group turns on you] plan to bring about the birth of the Antichrist to drive disbelievers back to the Church. In a hidden chamber Margaret finds files of [deformed babies, all marked with three sixes|images|wounded and changing bodies], and a night at a disco she cannot remember [comes back to her|wrong|sexual violation].
